data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
code_version: f6e2fbe1e3afb70ff192a61c011916449b6b59ae

### 2. Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior
preflight_python_runtime should verify the configured Lambda runtime (python3.13) is supported by AWS Lambda, or skip if no valid API exists.

#### Actual Behavior
Line 183: '_aws_lambda list-runtimes --output json' — AWS CLI rejects with ParamValidation: 'argument operation: Found invalid choice list-runtimes'. AWS Lambda has no list-runtimes API. The closest is to call create-function and observe the failure.

Verified: 'aws lambda help' shows valid subcommands; list-runtimes is not among them. The script's preflight cannot succeed under any AWS CLI version.

Impact: blocks 73d7-1968 (live e2e self-use validation) closure; aws-setup-lambda.sh exits before creating the IAM role or Lambda function.

#### Suggested Fix
Replace preflight_python_runtime with either: (a) a hardcoded sanity check against KNOWN_SUPPORTED_RUNTIMES (python3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13) — fails fast if LAMBDA_RUNTIME constant is outside the list; (b) a no-op preflight that relies on aws lambda create-function to surface unsupported-runtime errors at the actual creation step. Pattern (a) is preferred for clearer error messages.
data.title: [aws-setup-lambda.sh]: preflight_python_runtime calls fictitious 'aws lambda list-runtimes' -> ParamValidation halts setup
